thread:
Jordan Park: Hiring asks to lock an offer for a Sr Data Scientist (remote US) today. Candidate counteroffered by current employer with a retention bonus if they stay. Manager proposes match + one-time retention signing bonus: base at band S4 cap (USD 175k) + $15k one-time retention, plus accelerated equity grant (one-time RSU tranche) if they join. Need approval to go to comp committee.
Leah Kim (People Ops): @Jordan matching counteroffers often need CPO or comp-committee approval when adding retention pay or above-band equity. Please confirm cost_center, budget_owner, and why conversion to FTE is low risk (if this is a contractor vs perm). Also need recruiting note about counteroffer timeline.
Jordan Park: cost_center: DS-ML-550, budget_owner: Jordan Park. Candidate is current IC at a competitor; joining reduces time-to-impact. No contractor talk; direct hire. Start target 2026-09-01. Recruiting asks candidate to decide in 48 hours.
Ravi Singh (Finance): Any uplift above S4 cap or one-off cash >10% of annual requires comp-committee and finance director approval. Equity acceleration needs comp committee. Please ping offers-bot to create APP ticket and include the recruiting offer doc link.
Jordan Park: Pasted recruiting note and offer calc to ticket.
offers-bot: Approval request created: APP-9333. Routing: people-ops -> finance -> comp-committee -> CPO. Link: https://redwood.in/offers/APP-9333
Leah Kim: Please add a one-line business rationale into APP-9333: helps approvals. Suggested: "Strategic hire to lead model evaluation and reduce inference cost by 20% YOY; counteroffer requires retention to secure candidate."
Jordan Park: Added rationale.
offers-bot: APP-9333 routed to Finance at 3056789145.
Ravi Singh: Finance provisional: cash OK pending comp committee on equity and CPO sign-off on retention. Approve conditional on cost-center funding test and headcount/comp plan alignment. :white_check_mark:
Maya Torres (Comp Committee): We need specifics on the RSU tranche: amount, vesting trigger, and whether it's a true acceleration or a sign-on grant. Also attach the offer spreadsheet.
Jordan Park: Proposed one-time RSU grant: 2,000 units (market value est $40k), cliff vest at 12 months if still employed; if candidate converts to manager role within 12 months, additional 1,000 units. Added spreadsheet link.
Maya Torres: Comp committee discussion: 2,000 RSU one-time grant OK as sign-on (not acceleration) but requires CPO approval for managerial contingent tranche. Approve cash retention $15k as one-time sign-on. Routing to CPO for final.
offers-bot: APP-9333 routed to CPO at 3056789158.
Leah Kim: Legal note: include a repayment clawback for the retention bonus if the employee voluntarily leaves within 6 months. Also standard IP + at-will language. Any objections?
Jordan Park: Clawback OK. Add to offer.
offers-bot: APP-9333 status: CPO approved at 3056789175. Final routing: People Ops to send offer. Link: https://redwood.in/offers/APP-9333
Leah Kim: I'll draft the offer letter with: S4 base 175k, $15k one-time retention (clawback if <6 months), 2,000 RSU sign-on (12-month cliff), decision deadline 48 hours, start 2026-09-01. ETA send: today EOD once payroll confirms start paperwork.
Jordan Park: Please also add hiring manager note about counteroffer time pressure in the offer email subject line. Thanks.
Leah Kim: Will do. People Ops will send centrally. offers-bot: APP-9333 closed: offer cleared to send at 3056789180.
